balance.caption: Your connection starts here
balance.detail: Open Add balance and complete your payment. Wait for the balance to arrive before activating access.

billing.caption: Pick your way to pay
billing.detail: Enable an hourly squad in Explore, or use eligible traffic-billed nodes directly with sufficient balance. No separate traffic-plan purchase is needed.

routing.caption: Your route. Your choice.
routing.detail: Need a custom route? Choose entry, template and exit in DIY Center, then save and wait for Applied. Otherwise keep the defaults.

client.caption: Choose your client
client.detail: Download a current Mihomo- or Xray-based client from its official project. Choose the version for your device and supported nodes.

import.caption: Copy. Paste. Refresh.
import.detail: Copy your current link from Subscription. Paste it into the client's subscription URL field, save and update; keep it private. Wait for first sync if no link appears.

connect.caption: Pick a node. You're ready.
connect.detail: Select an available node and start the client. Enable its system proxy or VPN/TUN as needed, then open a website to check the connection.

entry.caption: A stronger start from China
entry.detail: Premium routes focus on China-to-overseas connectivity. Use an encrypted client connection through an optimized entry to reach overseas services.

conditions.caption: The route makes the difference
conditions.detail: Carrier, route, location and congestion shape speed. Premium transit alone does not bypass filtering.

international.caption: Take your connection further
international.detail: International transit connects countries and continents for overseas access and onward routes.

reputation.caption: Speed and reputation are different
reputation.detail: A data-center exit may be classified as hosting. Reputation depends on the actual IP and usage, not a universal quality grade.

broadband.caption: Exit through a local ISP
broadband.detail: Broadband exits provide a local ISP network environment for everyday social media, e-commerce and AI work.

services.caption: A local exit. Realistic expectations.
services.detail: A local ISP connection cannot prove residency, guarantee account acceptance or prevent an AI service from changing its behavior.

pairing.caption: Build the route that fits
pairing.detail: Where supported, pair a China Optimized entry with an International or Broadband exit. The destination sees the final exit's public IP.

destination.caption: Good entry. Right exit.
destination.detail: The entry shapes your route; the exit shapes your public IP. Service-side checks still apply.

invoice.caption: Match three things. Pay confidently.
invoice.detail: Copy the token, network and receiving address from the current invoice. Check every field before sending.

deadline.caption: Every decimal counts
deadline.detail: Send the full invoice amount before its payment window closes. A cheaper network is not a substitute for the invoice's network.

gas.caption: Payment goes here. Gas goes there.
gas.detail: TX receives the invoice amount; the network receives gas separately. Check the wallet's fee estimate without adding gas to the stablecoin amount.

resources.caption: Keep a little room for fees
resources.detail: Keep fee funds available; some wallets sponsor or convert fees. Follow your wallet's current estimate.

withdrawal.caption: The received amount is what matters
withdrawal.detail: An exchange or custodial wallet may deduct its withdrawal fee. Adjust the withdrawal total so TX receives exactly the invoice amount.

preview.caption: One preview. Fewer surprises.
preview.detail: Check the final received-amount preview. A mismatch may prevent automatic credit; the numbers shown are illustrative.

confirmation.caption: Sent? Let confirmation finish.
confirmation.detail: Wait for on-chain confirmation and payment processing. If payment stays unsettled, message the bot; do not pay again during review.

support.caption: A message gets help moving
support.detail: DM the bot with the order number, network and transaction hash. Never share your wallet seed phrase or private key.

cgnat.caption: One IP. Plenty of everyday users.
cgnat.detail: Providers widely use carrier-grade NAT. Hundreds of households or mobile users can share one public IPv4 address.

neighbors.caption: Sharing alone is not abuse
neighbors.detail: A shared address does not itself prove abuse. Shared-IP blocks can still affect innocent users.

node.caption: Each node has its own IP
node.detail: TX gives each node a standalone public IP, rather than an upstream shared-NAT allocation.

members.caption: A node IP, shared by its members
members.detail: Members of that node share its exit address. A dedicated node IP is not a separate private IP for every member.

controls.caption: Smaller groups. Clear boundaries.
controls.detail: We limit membership and use protocol recognition and connection-count controls to protect shared capacity.

boundaries.caption: Keep avoidable risk out
boundaries.detail: Blocking crawlers, bulk sign-ups, torrents and resharing reduces needless load and reputation risk. No control removes every risk.

signals.caption: Services see more than an IP
signals.detail: Platforms assess IP reputation, device and browser signals, account history and behavior.

support.caption: Controlled sharing. Human support.
support.detail: Verification, restrictions and service-quality changes remain possible. Message the bot when access behaves unexpectedly.

everyday.caption: Browse. Stream. Play.
everyday.detail: Everyday browsing, streaming and gaming are welcome. Keep use within your purchased access and limits.

platforms.caption: Work. Create. Keep it fair.
platforms.detail: AI and legitimate social-media or e-commerce work are welcome. Follow each platform's account rules and your access limits.

private.caption: Your access stays with you
private.detail: Do not share or resell access or expose an open proxy. Protect your subscription link.

automation.caption: Real use, without the bot farms
automation.detail: Crawlers, bulk registration tools and account factories create abnormal traffic and put other members' access at risk.

torrents.caption: Keep the lane clear
torrents.detail: BT/PT traffic, spam and network attacks are prohibited. Shared capacity is for normal use.

abuse.caption: Protect the people on both ends
abuse.detail: No malware delivery, credential attacks or automated high-volume activity that exhausts connections or harms others.

controls.caption: Fair use, actively protected
controls.detail: Protocol recognition and connection-count limits help enforce acceptable use and protect shared capacity.

support.caption: Ordinary use affected? We're here.
support.detail: Recognition has limits; undetected prohibited activity is still prohibited. Message the bot if normal use is affected.

choice.caption: Make access fit your day
choice.detail: Choose hourly access or traffic charging where offered. Pick the approach that suits your usage.

terms.caption: Know what you're paying for
terms.detail: Review each squad's displayed price and limits. The billing tutorials show exactly what triggers a charge.

project.caption: Built here. Maintained here.
project.detail: VanSail Carpool is our own maintained project, covering the member experience, billing and X-Node integration.

improve.caption: A direct line to the code
improve.detail: We can investigate issues and improve the software directly, with control over our own feature set.

quality.caption: Quality with someone accountable
quality.detail: We maintain the service and investigate reported quality problems. Tell us when something goes wrong.

recover.caption: Support when you need it
recover.detail: Networks can fail and destinations can impose restrictions. Our commitment is to investigate and help.

privacy.caption: Privacy, with clear boundaries
privacy.detail: Live connection observations are transient, not retained browsing history. Necessary account, payment and traffic-accounting records remain.

support.caption: One message away
support.detail: For setup, payment or access help, send the bot a direct message. Get help from the people maintaining TX.
